name: spendmate-ai
description: AI-powered personal finance tracker built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, JWT Authentication, Analytics Dashboard, Budget Planning, Savings Goals, and AI Financial Insights.

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
